title: Clarify thermite-design.md §6: slag is L1-contract-enforced; L0 is the body-proof aspect

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Added a §6 Rules bullet: L0 = body-proof aspect (trusted by fiat, recorded by the slag flag); a #[slag] fn's contract is L1-enforced -> cert is L1 + slag:true, not L0. slag exempts proving, never stating/checking. Matches forge's enforced behavior (#6). Thesis now consistent with §8 + the implementation.
